faqs.answer: Spearson's Group is a construction and home improvement company located at 31a Church Street, Gamlingay, Sandy SG19 3JH. They offer services including bathrooms, kitchen renovations, extensions, loft conversions, carpentry and joinery, plumbing and heating, and electrical work. The company provides bespoke CAD drawings and 3D visualizations for projects. Business hours are Monday to Friday 7:30am to 5:00pm, Saturday 7:30am to 2:00pm, and closed Sundays. Contact them at 07827445900 or info@spearsons.co.uk.
